figure_reading: Residual is EXACTLY zero on every node receiving 1, 2 or 3 contributions (20,139 nodes) and appears only at degree >= 4, at 1-2 ULP of the largest force. That is the signature of non-deterministic atomic summation order, which both arms have and neither controls. A wrong index would not respect the node's degree, so the staircase is itself evidence the addressing is right rather than merely close.
